news.title: SLU Completes JED Campus Initiative, Becomes Alumni Campus
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University has completed its four-year partnership with the JED Foundation and has officially become a JED Campus Alumni institution. SLU began its partnership with the JED Foundation in fall 2022 as part of a University-wide effort to strengthen student mental health, suicide prevention, and well-being resources. news.title: Chaifetz Students Create Supply Chain Solution for Local Drink Company
news.summary_en: Students in the Richard A. Chaifetz School of Business had the opportunity to compete to take a supply-chain system that contained interruptions and find ways to make it run smoothly. The winning proposal was presented to the leadership of Karviva on Sept. 18. St. Louis-based wellness beverage company Karviva, was founded by Angela Zeng, Ph.D. (Med '01).
